doc: Experiment contracts: every registered hourly leg declares hypothesis, metric, falsifier, budget and owner (libs/tiers/experiment_contract.py). budget and owner are DERIVED from hourly_cycle.LEG_BUDGET_SEC / LEG_DEPARTMENT when absent; the metric half is DERIVED from tier_s_program.json leg_contracts when that programme wrote one. Fence: scripts/check_experiment_contracts.py (law gate). Hourly reading: leg experiment_contracts -> desks/mt5/reports/EXPERIMENT_CONTRACTS.json.

build_failure_bank.hypothesis: Ranking every cell that failed to BUILD by cause class turns silently dropped cells into named fix work, so the failed-to-build count falls as the top causes are fixed.

falsifier.after: 24h window: no stage recorded a build pass, so the bank is not hooked into the stages it claims to watch

trade_pathology.hypothesis: Classifying the live book's bad trades by execution pathology separates machine defects (slippage, stale signals, weekend gaps, spread spikes, instant stop-outs) from market losses, and the flagged share falls as they are fixed.

falsifier.after: 7 days: under 5% of closed deals join their decision intent, so four of the six classes cannot be measured

experiment_contracts.hypothesis: Declaring hypothesis, metric, falsifier, budget and owner for every research leg makes each hour of compute answerable to a measured claim; contract coverage rises as the grandfathered backlog shrinks.

falsifier.after: 30 days: fewer contracted legs than on the day the fence landed

health_board.hypothesis: One verdict per organ, joined from the runtime attestation, the event log, the acceptance properties and the box watchdog, surfaces a failing organ within the hour instead of across five artifacts.

falsifier.after: any pass: a board judging no organ has lost its source

tier_s.hypothesis: Evaluating all 46 Tier S layers against their admission contracts every hour shows which layers produce a measured gain over their own baseline.

falsifier.after: 30 days of readings with no layer ADMITTED

adversary_evolution.hypothesis: An evolved adversary finds gaps in the ten gates that the fixed red-team suite does not, raising falsification power.

falsifier.after: 30 days with no breach found: the evolution adds nothing

execution_science.hypothesis: Attributing gross-minus-net growth to execution names the drag that better order handling would recover.

falsifier.after: the measured drag exceeds all gross growth, i.e. the attribution is broken

frontier_map.hypothesis: Mapping certificates onto the research frontier shows where certified alpha sits and where the frontier is unexplored.

falsifier.after: any pass with certificates on the box but none on the map

market_ecology.hypothesis: Participant footprints detected against a block-permuted null are real structure that research can target.

falsifier.after: 30 days with no footprint beating the null

research_diversity_archive.hypothesis: Keeping an archive of occupied research niches preserves diversity so the search does not collapse onto one mechanism.

falsifier.after: the archive collapses to a single niche

committees.hypothesis: Two LLM committees arguing competing explanations for a candidate, settled later against the gauntlet's own verdict, kill wrong cells more often than right ones and so save gauntlet compute; their kill precision is measured, never assumed.

falsifier.after: 50 settled kills (committees.MIN_SETTLED): the committee's kills are wrong more often than right, its own scrap rule

decay_monitor.hypothesis: Judging every LIVE sleeve's trailing live trades by promotion's own thresholds with the sign flipped retires a decayed sleeve before its drawdown compounds, and a fitted half-life queues its successor hunt before the edge fades.

falsifier.after: 7 days with LIVE rows on the roster (roster_rows_seen > 0) and none judged: the verdict loop is not reading the roster the promoter writes

fill_markout.hypothesis: Joining every order intent to its fill and its closing deal measures the slippage the book actually pays in R, so execution drag is a number the desk can drive down instead of an assumption in the backtest.

falsifier.after: 7 days with deals on the ledger and no intent matched to a fill: the markout measures nothing

kelly_survival.hypothesis: Solving each gold window's size for maximum ruin-counted E[log W] subject to P(death) <= eps grows the book faster than today's floor book at no more ruin, so survival takes size away only where that raises growth.

falsifier.after: 30 days of readings in which the solved book grows slower than today's: survival is costing growth rather than protecting it (growth governance Rule 1)

grandfathered_note: Legs registered uncontracted on 2026-09-30, when the fence was built. The list may only shrink (grandfathered_max is its ratchet); a NEW leg must be born with a contract.
